timing: Post hoc diagnosis of completed v0.8; before selection or training of a v0.9 intervention
method: Read all 49 stored goal-conditioned physical-action pairs. A heldout map is reachable iff any complete message decodes both locations correctly. Compare the same validation-photo natural joint rate; no model inference or new random draws.
statistical_unit: Four training seeds; average three splits and two directions within each seed before macro averaging
notes: The codebook source-goal index is duplicated bookkeeping under hidden goals, not an additional scene or replication.
Receiver coverage is an oracle upper bound for a fixed current receiver and its actual zero-inventory/history context, not performance of a trained new sender.
If no code exists, changing only the sender cannot make that map jointly correct with this fixed receiver.

If a code exists but natural communication fails, the sender does not use all reachable performance; this does not localize perception versus message selection or prove a new training method would find the code.
Artificial full-code selection does not establish token compositionality.
